user.title: Create an Adaptive TTS entity
user.description: Choose the TTS entity Adaptive TTS should wrap.

policy.title: Configure quiet hours
policy.description: The selected provider's supported option names are shown below. Home Assistant Cloud voice variants use the voice option. If the start and end times are the same, quiet mode is active all day.

language.title: Choose quiet voice language
language.description: Choose the language/accent family to use during quiet hours. The next step will show voices available for this language. This can differ from the Assist pipeline language.

override.title: Configure the quiet override
override.description: Choose a listed voice when available, or enter the provider's exact voice/style value.

error.provider_not_found: The selected TTS entity is not currently available.
error.recursive_provider: Adaptive TTS entities cannot wrap other Adaptive TTS entities.
error.unsupported_option: The selected option is not supported by this provider.
error.unsupported_language: The selected language is not supported by this provider.

abort.provider_not_found: The selected TTS entity is no longer available.
